final: SELECT g.store_id, g.cnt, 1.0*g.cnt/t.total, 1.0*g.cnt/a.avg_cnt FROM (SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer WHERE store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id) g CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer WHERE store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id)) t CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer WHERE store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id)) a ORDER BY g.store_id
